New standard and/ or amendments:
Amendments to IAS 1,
‘Presentation of Financial
Statements’ - Non-cur-
rent liabilities with cove-
nants
Details of the amendments:
These amendments clarify how conditions with which
an entity must comply within twelve months after the
reporting period affect the classification of a liability.
The amendments also aim to improve information an
entity provides related to liabilities subject to these
conditions.
Assessment of the impact on the Group fi:
The Group anticipates no
material impact to its
financial statements.

New standard and/ or amendments:
Amendment to IFRS 16,
‘Leases’ - sale and lease-
back
Details of the amendments:
These amendments include requirements for sale and
leaseback transactions in IFRS 16 to explain how an
entity accounts for a sale and leaseback after the date
of the transaction. Sale and leaseback transactions
where some or all the lease payments are variable
lease payments that do not depend on an index or
rate are most likely to be impacted.
Assessment of the impact on the Group fi:
The Group anticipates
no impact to its financial
statements.

New standard and/ or amendments:
Amendments to Supplier
Finance Arrangements
(IAS 7 ‘Statement of Cash
Flows’ and IFRS 7 ‘Finan-
cial Instruments: Disclo-
sure’)
Details of the amendments:
These amendments require disclosures to enhance
the transparency of supplier finance arrangements
and their effects on a company’s liabilities, cash flows
and exposure to liquidity risk. The disclosure require-
ments are the IASB’s response to investors’ concerns
that some companies’ supplier finance arrangements
are not sufficiently visible, hindering investors’ analy-
sis.
Assessment of the impact on the Group fi:
The Group anticipates
no impact to its financial
statements.
